entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Michael. Pulling that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 24th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. I was just sitting on the couch and it said my heart rate was 150. This thing is just... it's **garbage**.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. The heart rate tracking should definitely be more reliable. I can either walk you through a quick calibration process or transfer you directly to our technical support team who are experts with the Pulse.
Oh, no, I **don't have time** for all that technical stuff. It's so complicated. I just want to send it back. I want my money back.

I understand you're looking for a simple solution. To process a return for a defect outside the initial return window, our policy requires that we first try to verify the fault with our technical team. It usually only takes a few minutes.
I just don't get it. I don't want a replacement, I want a **refund**. Why is this so hard? I feel like you **just want money** and you're making it impossible. Can't you just help me?

I understand your frustration, Michael, and I want to be transparent. Looking at your order, the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. Because this specific device is a health monitor that syncs with personal data, it has a strict 10-day return window for a refund.
Ten days? I... I'm so confused. I thought it was 90 days. I didn't see that on the website. This is all so overwhelming. Are you saying I can't return it at all?

I apologize for any confusion on the website. For a straightforward return, we are past the 10-day policy. For a defect claim, we have to verify the issue. Without that verification, I'm bound by the policy and my system won't allow me to process a refund.
So I'm just stuck with a broken product? This is a mess. I just don't understand what I'm supposed to do now.

You're not stuck with a broken product. Our warranty covers defects, and our technical team is the first step for that. They are excellent and can authorize a replacement if it's found to be faulty. I can transfer you right now.
I guess not. I just... I need to think. This wasn't what I was expecting. Thanks, I guess.
I'm sorry we couldn't reach the outcome you wanted today, Michael. The offer to speak with tech support still stands if you change your mind. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
